C0526.title: Shanghai Lawyer Shares Dispute Over Including Prepaid Postage in Turnover for Illegal Business Operations Case
C0526.summary: In September 2025, lawyer Shao Shiwei published an article summarizing a defense case involving alleged illegal business operations for selling overseas audiovisual products without a license. The article discussed determination of illegal business amount, the nature of sales conduct, the boundary between administrative violation and criminal offense, and defense strategy, highlighting the need in similar cases to distinguish actual business gains, prepaid costs, and whether criminal prosecution thresholds are met.

references.title: Lawyer Shao Shiwei: Real case of illegal business crime, lawyer successfully defends for innocence - Shanghai Rule of Law Daily
